title: Ticwatch Pro & MM2 - Can't use "Enable Wear Collection Service"
body:
Hi,

Just bought a Miaomiao 2 and a Ticwatch Pro.

Have successfully configured xDrip+ both on my Honor 8x and my Ticwatch Pro, but I can't seem to find a way to get the "Enable Wear Collection Service" working.
I want always get Miaomiao's readings on the Honor 8x, but everytime it's unavailable (let's say I'm playing soccer and the smartphone is at the locker room), the Ticwatch should start receiving the MM readings.

I tried turning off the smartphone and nothing happens on the watch, even after 10 or 15 minutes.

Will you be so kind to give me a hand at this?
Thank you so much.
